notes: Five more passes, this time against the installed app rather than the source. The Corners window broke when you asked for 3 turns: fewer rows means taller rows and the font follows the row height, so the label column grew wider than the panel - the GEAR caption landed on the B/A/G headers and the lights were pushed off the right edge. The font now shrinks until the label leaves room for the lights, and the GEAR caption is right-aligned to the gear column, ending where the lights begin (bounding it the obvious way fixed the collision but hid it at the default window width). The Stint window turns button was invisible but still clickable, because that window paints its own title bar - it now draws AUTO / 3 / 5 / 7 like the Corners window. And building a debrief can now be told not to share: writing one is a deliberate act and still contributes by default, but there was no way to say otherwise, so anything rebuilding debriefs in bulk republished laps and earned points for them. All eight fixes from 0.9.165 were re-verified in the shipped build: a corrupt telemetry file is refused in 20 ms with memory flat, sixty sessions add 152 MB where 160 used to reach 3.9 GB, compare and the corner tree no longer crash, and all nine manual images load. Stability over 2,174 calls in five minutes: memory fell from 483 MB to 386, handles flat, one process, median response 42 ms, no errors.
